describe: The image shows a close-up of a single teal-green eye seen straight on, with a dark, fine-streaked iris. A bright white specular highlight sits at the top of the iris above a round black pupil. The lower iris glows cyan and pale teal, brightest along the bottom rim, fading to near-black at the edges. A small faint 'gettyimages' watermark appears in the upper left. Black background.
